question: Which amendment to the Constitution of India added a new subject in the Union List called 'taxes on services’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**88th**.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The division of powers between the Union and the States is in the Seventh Schedule.
 
• Seventh Schedule
 
• It contains three lists:
 
 
• Union List,
 
• State List and
 
• Concurrent List
 
 
 
• 7th Schedule of Indian Constitution – Union List had 97 subjects.
 
• Now, it has 100 subjects.
 
 
• 88th Amendment added a new subject in the Union List called ‘taxes on services.’
 
 
 
• The state list has 61 subjects. Earlier, it had 66 items.
 
 
• The 69th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1991 made special provisions in relation to National Capital.
 
• Laws cannot be made by the Delhi government on three subjects under State List named as – Public Order, Police & Land.
 
 
 
• The concurrent list has 52 subjects enumerated under it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• 85th Amendment:

 
 
• Reservation in promotion for Scheduled Caste tribe candidates in government services.
 
 
 
• 87th Amendment: 
 
 
• ​Extend the usage of 2001 national census population figures for statewide distribution of parliamentary seats.
 
 
 
• 88th Amendment (2003):
 
 
• ​Provision of tax on services.
 
 
 
• 91st Amendment (2003) :
 
 
• Amendment in party change system, recognition of merger of an entire party only.
 
 
 
• 56th Amendment:
 
 
• 56nd Amendment Act, 1987 of the Indian Constitution conferred Statehood on Goa and forms a new Union Territory of Daman and Diu.
 
• Goa thus became the 25th State of the Indian Republic.
 
 
 
• 62nd Amendment:
 
 
• The 62nd Amendment Act extends by 10 years the reservation of seats for the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies as well as nomination representatives of the Anglo-Indian community.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
 

 Third Schedule

 Fifth Schedule.
